body.processed: softWoRx® 5.0 is the latest in DeltaVision image acquisition software. Find samples, acquire images and process data quickly and efficiently with the intuitive user interface. softWoRx 5.0 includes visualization and measurement tools and exports data in a wide variety of formats making it a versatile tool for more than just image acquisition.
